# CWE-798: AWS account ID — numeric identifier in source.
# 12-digit account IDs aid targeted phishing and policy abuse. The rule
# flags 12-digit numbers labeled as account_id; ok lines are short or
# not labeled as AWS accounts.
# ruleid: detected-aws-account-id
aws_account_id = 287139315271
# ruleid: detected-aws-account-id
"aws_account_id": "987654321098"
# ok: detected-aws-account-id
aws_account_id = 12345
# ok: detected-aws-account-id
account_id = "000000000000"
# ruleid: detected-aws-account-id
aws_account_id = 111222333444
# ruleid: detected-aws-account-id
"aws_account_id": "555666777888"
# ok: detected-aws-account-id
aws_account_id = "example_000000000000"
